cwe_content.cwe: CWE-89,Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

candidate.Reason: Directly appends user-controlled input (orderBy and sortOrder) to SQL query without proper sanitization or parameterization, creating SQL injection vulnerability
Directly appends user-controlled input (limit and offset) to SQL query without proper sanitization or parameterization, creating SQL injection vulnerability
Combines multiple SQL injection vulnerabilities from orderBySql() and limitSql() methods without proper sanitization
